notes.title: July 16, 2025 - Update
notes.notes:
- Added change log

- Added feedback/bug report form button!

- Added analytics

- Explosive bullets should no longer trigger multiple explosions unless bounce is equipped (most notably prevents poison from stacking multiple times from a single bullet)

- Charge + Gatling should now be more exciting, albeit a bit chaotic

- Charge + Cannon should no longer take literally forever

- Cannon + Bounce should no longer result in bullets being limply pooped out of the gun (sorry!)

- Charge shot should now have some visual feedback on the cross hair when charge is complete

- Poison and Rupture should now both be affected by the Peashooter Overtime Bonus

- Escape button should now back out of most menu screens

- Reduced chromatic aberration on the ship interior's screen; if it's still too much, LET US KNOW!

- Minor secondary fire rate fix

- Glass effect from credits is now also used in the Options menu on the Main Menu screen

- Removed screen shake from charge shot (updating to gun shake in the future)

- Fixed various dialogue issues

- Minor map tweaks

- Rupture and Poison reworks!

- Rupture and Poison should now act appropriately when landing enhanced bullets

- Nerfed base gun damage upgrade

- Reload speed issue fixed

- Nerfed reload speed slightly

- Various mod balance changes

- Tutorial text reworded (not currently translated)

- Minor mission re-balancing

- Infinite mission health scaling reduced a bit

- HUD should no longer struggle to display on screens with weird aspect ratios

- Aspect ratios locked to multiples of 16:9 and 16:10 for now, as a workaround for the above

- Mouse input should no longer become jittery after dying and respawning

- Freeze turret should actually work again

- Explody-plants should flash slightly more obviously

- When Crawlers phase into the ground on the Tutorial mission due to lag, they should now rest in peace instead of rotting in purgatory

- Dialogue box made more prominent

- Shop and Load out tutorial boxes made more eye-catching (color change)
